title: Sources: technical staff at several Chinese humanoid robot makers have been denied US visas ahead of CES, hampering their efforts to showcase their hardware (Nikkei Asia)
summary: Nikkei Asia: Sources: technical staff at several Chinese humanoid robot makers have been denied US visas ahead of CES, hampering their efforts to showcase their hardware — HONG KONG — Researchers and engineers at several Chinese humanoid robot makers, including Xpeng and Engine AI, have been denied U.S. visas …
